lookbackDuration.description:
Defined in number of seconds, this field represents the duration of historical data
required to run model inference for a timestamp `t`.
An example is a model which needs `t-4hours : t` duration of data to make a prediction
for timestamp `t`. In this example, {@link lookbackDuration} must be set to 14,400, i.e.,
14,400 seconds = 4 hours.

vertices.description: List of all vertices in this graph.

edges.description: List of all edges in this graph.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

scoreNames.description: Names of the {@link #score} outputs for this machine learning pipeline.

trainRun.description:
Single workflow run triggered by training of this {@link MlPipeline}.

NOTE: due to the immutability of pipelines, each training produces a new instance, which means that each pipeline
instance can only be associated with a single training run.
Also, keep in mind that a {@link WorkflowExecutorRun} might be periodically cleaned up, so this reference might
not be always resolvable.

trainStatus.description:
Status of {@link #trainRun}. Holds important meta information (e.g. `startedby`) that needs to be persisted with this pipeline,
even if the {@link #trainRun} reference is eventually cleaned up.

doNotAutoUpsert.description:
Controls the behavior of {@link MlPipeline#beforeMake}
If set, all the {@link MlPipe}s referenced by this {@link MlPipeline} are not upserted.

algorithmPipe.description:
Optional custom pipe that generates outputs to be consumed by the {@link #alertPipe}.
This pipe can be used to calculate risk scores or other metrics that will be fed into the alerting pipe for final decision making.

Example: The `algorithmPipe` may output a risk score that indicates the likelihood of an asset failure or an anomaly.

alertPipe.description:
A custom pipe responsible for generating an `alert` based on the 9 input features and any additional outputs from the {@link #algorithmPipe}.
This pipe applies alerting logic to decide when an alert should be triggered.

Example: The `alertPipe` could output a binary value indicating whether an alert should be raised for a specific asset at a particular time.

pipeToInterpret.description:
Defines which pipe's output should be interpreted or visualized.
The choices are either the `algorithmPipe` (e.g., risk score, other calculated metrics) or the `alertPipe` (e.g., alerts, predictions).

hasTarget.description:
If the pipeline involves supervised learning, this flag should be set to `true` to indicate the presence of a target variable.
This enables training functionality within the pipeline.

trainingMasks.description:
A list of all the categories of masks that should be applied during training to filter out unwanted data points.
There are 7 types of masks in total. By default, 6 masks are applied to remove data that is not suitable for model training.

Masks can be customized by modifying this list to control which data points are used during training.

Default masks:
- mask_IsAssetNotOperational
- mask_AssetEvent
- mask_PreAssetEvent
- mask_PostAssetEvent
- mask_AdHocTraining
- mask_AlgorithmicallyComputed

inferenceMasks.description:
A list of masks that should be applied during inference (model prediction) to filter out unwanted data points.
By default, 4 masks are applied for inference. Similar to `trainingMasks`, these can be customized for specific inference use cases.

Default masks:
- mask_IsAssetNotOperational
- mask_AssetEvent
- mask_PostAssetEvent
- mask_AdHocInference

hpoJobId.description:
The ID of the Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) job that created this pipeline.
If no HPO job was used, this value will be empty.

title:
This type represents a project agnostic pipeline that can be used for different use cases within the C3 AI Reliability application.
The pipeline processes time-series data of assets, applies various masks to exclude unwanted data points, and outputs alerts,
risk scores, or other artifacts.

The pipeline supports both training and inference and can generate alerts based on operational conditions or other predictive outcomes.
Customization is enabled via optional custom pipes for advanced data processing logic.

The pipeline requires 9 mandatory inputs and 1 optional input. Each input should be of type {@link Data} with `subject` and `timestamp` columns.

The outputs include at least one artifact, typically an alert, and optionally, outputs from custom pipes such as risk scores.
name: ReliabilityMl.Pipeline
